---
title: "Research workflow"
---

This standard workflow adapts the minimal reflowR layout and adds reviewed
stages for import, structural checks, tidy role selection, descriptive tables,
accessible figures, explanatory models, diagnostics and effect estimates. The
renderer is explicitly `rmarkdown::render_site`; neither `reflow_init()` nor
workflowr is invoked. Source revision, file hashes, changes and license are in
`../metadata/workflow-template.json` and `../licenses/reflowR-MIT.txt`.

Project creation does not read data, install dependencies, initialize Git,
render pages or approve an analysis. Stage selection, package pins and approval
status are listed in `../config/workflow.yml`.

From the project root:

1. `Rscript code/run_demo.R` runs every reviewed stage on constructed synthetic
   data and compares the model adapters with independent reference
   computations. Results are written to `demo/` and labelled synthetic.
2. `Rscript code/run_workflow.R` analyses registered study data only after the
   mapping, reviewed model settings, analysis approval, a local data binding in
   `.cttir/local.yml`, approved stage adapters and matching installed package
   versions are all present. Otherwise it stops and lists what is missing.
3. `Rscript code/render_report.R` renders these pages into `docs/`. Review any
   edits to these R Markdown files first: rendering executes their code.

Publication-specific outputs belong under `publications/`, with dataset IDs
referencing the shared registry. No study conclusions are generated here.
